# Gust

> Single-line text transitions for React. Gust keeps matching text at both ends and animates the changed middle.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://gust.manikrana.dev/gust.md): installation, props, motion settings, and limits.
- [README](https://github.com/Maniktherana/gust#readme): usage and development.
- [Examples](https://gust.manikrana.dev/examples)
- [Engine](https://gust.manikrana.dev/engine): optional motion controls.

## Usage

- Install with `npm install @maniktherana/gust`, then `import { Gust } from "@maniktherana/gust"`.
- Render `<Gust>{text}</Gust>` with a string or number. The first value is static; updates animate. Styles are included.
- Use `as`, `className`, `style`, HTML attributes, and `ref` on the outer element.
- Use `animated={false}` for immediate updates. Reduced-motion preferences also disable animation.
- `direction` accepts `up`, `down`, `left`, or `right`. It overrides motion angles and `trend`. Default `trend="auto"` compares raw finite numbers, not formatted strings; explicit motion angles override it.
- `preservePrefix={false}` replaces the entire value. This prop overrides `motion.preserveMatching`.
- Pass optional `GustMotionOptions` through `motion`. Entry and exit default to 440ms, with a spring entrance and a 30% stagger spread.
- Single-line plain text only, without cross-character kerning or ligatures. Format values before passing them to Gust.
- Visual duplicates are hidden from assistive technology. Add a live region when text changes need announcements.
